import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }
        int n1 = n / 2;
        List<Long> a1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Long> a2 = new ArrayList<>();
        sums1(0, 0, a, m, n1, a1);
        sums2(n1, 0, a, m, n, a2);
        // Deduplicate and sort a1
        Set<Long> set = new TreeSet<>(a1);
        long[] a1Sorted = new long[set.size()];
        int idx = 0;
        for (long val : set) {
            a1Sorted[idx++] = val;
        }
        long ans = 0;
        for (long i : a2) {
            long target = m - i;
            int j = Arrays.binarySearch(a1Sorted, target);
            if (j < 0) {
                j = -j - 1; // insertion point
            }
            // j is first index where a1Sorted[j] >= target
            if (j > 0) {
                ans = Math.max(ans, a1Sorted[j - 1] + i);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    private static void sums1(int i, long sum, long[] a, long m, int n1, List<Long> a1) {
        if (i == n1) {
            a1.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums1(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m, a, m, n1, a1);
            sums1(i + 1, sum, a, m, n1, a1);
        }
    }

    private static void sums2(int i, long sum, long[] a, long m, int n, List<Long> a2) {
        if (i == n) {
            a2.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums2(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m, a, m, n, a2);
            sums2(i + 1, sum, a, m, n, a2);
        }
    }
}
